source_row.extraction_instructions: Umbraco (101 Ltd), server-rendered. The calendar page is one list of a.card.eventCard cards (title, date line, location, 'N Days' badge); GOTCHA: the card date is the LAST day of the event (OOPS card '26 January 2027' vs detail '25 January 2027 - 26 January 2027'), so the ~9 detail pages are read in the listing phase and their header range becomes the shell date. Course sub-pages (Registration, Registration & Fees, Course information) sit in the side menu; fees are a grid of div.bg-pale rows (label | small 'Members' qualifier | price) on the registration page, 'free to attend' prose on some. The flagship ABS Conference 2027 (10-11 May 2027, Wales) is not on the calendar and is added from its own page, with its Abstracts & Bursaries sub-page giving abstract status and deadline.

registry_comment: ABS courses & events: Umbraco calendar cards (card date = last day, so details read in listing), registration sub-page fee grid, ABS Conference page + abstracts sub-page

concerns: Coverage checklist: #1 verified (card date is the last day; detail range used); #4 registration sub-pages followed through the side menu (paths differ: /registration/ vs /registration-fees/); #6/#7 ABS Conference abstract status and deadline read from its Abstracts & Bursaries sub-page - NOTE the shared abstract_classifier returned open=False for this page ('Once the abstract deadline has passed, it will not be possible to make alterations…' reads as a closed call), so the extractor sets open=True when a FUTURE deadline and explicit 'now open' wording coexist (a shared-classifier false negative worth fixing); #2/#5 West Midlands Chapter Meeting registers through a Google Form (fee unknown) and the IBCC Dublin page only has a 'keep me informed' EventsAir link; #3 none seen.

Advanced Skills in Breast Disease Management (Cambridge): the calendar card lists TWO dates (21 April 2027 '3 Days' and 11 May 2027 '2 Days', 'Coming soon') but the detail page gives only 19-21 April 2027 and no fees; only the verified range is emitted, no second session is invented. Fees not yet published (registration sub-page 404).

The ABS Conference 2027 venue is only 'Wales' (no city); fees 'More information will be available in due course'. ABS South East Central Regional Meeting is free to attend (one £0 tier from the registration page). Members/non-member qualifiers are kept in the tier label.

The calendar page is read plus each detail page in the listing phase (<= 20 fetches) and one registration sub-page per event during detail extraction. 'Royal College of Surgeons of England' venues are mapped to London (the ABS's own address) because the page gives no city.

Text-LLM chain on 2026-10-21: nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b and meta/muse-glimmer-30b both answered 404 'gone', so the harness descriptions/specialties came from openai/gpt-oss-20b. Descriptions and specialty have deterministic backstops (first real paragraph; per-society default specialty), so extraction does not depend on the LLM. The probe_models job will go red until the chain is rotated.

specialty_classifier.classify_specialty is deliberately NOT used as the backstop: on single-specialty societies it returned wrong labels (Cardiology/Oncology/GP Training for hepatology webinars). The backstop is the society's own specialty constant when the LLM returns None.

Shared-helper wishes (not changed, per rules): pricing_tables.parse_pricing_tables keeps only the LAST price column when the header names are not timeframes (BSSH Scientific Meeting 'Full meeting | One day' lost the full-meeting rates), drops the category column of [Ticket | Category | Price] tables (BAUS), and can take a nearby sentence as the section name ('Registration fees do not include'). Each extractor carries a small local table helper instead (matrix_tiers / ticket_tiers / rowspan_tiers / external_fee_hop, duplicated inline per file).
